summary: Create a function app. The function app's name must be able to produce a unique FQDN as AppName.azurewebsites.net.

parameters.name: --name
parameters.help: Name of the new function app.

parameters.name: --resource-group
parameters.help: Name of resource group. You can configure the default group using `az configure --defaults group=<name>`.

parameters.name: --storage-account
parameters.help: Provide a string value of a Storage Account in the provided Resource Group. Or Resource ID of a Storage Account in a different Resource Group.

parameters.name: --always-ready-instances
parameters.help: Space-separated configuration for the number of pre-allocated instances in the format `<name>=<value>`.

parameters.name: --app-insights
parameters.help: Name of the existing App Insights project to be added to the function app. Must be in the same resource group.

parameters.name: --app-insights-key
parameters.help: Instrumentation key of App Insights to be added.

parameters.name: --assign-identity
parameters.help: Accept system or user assigned identities separated by spaces. Use '[system]' to refer system assigned identity, or a resource id to refer user assigned identity. Check out help for more examples.

parameters.name: --cnl
parameters.help: Use this option if you want to configure networking later for an app using network- restricted storage.

parameters.name: --consumption-plan-location
parameters.help: Geographic location where function app will be hosted. Use `az functionapp list-consumption- locations` to view available locations.

parameters.name: --cpu
parameters.help: The CPU in cores of the container app. e.g 0.75. WARNING: Argument '--cpu' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --dal
parameters.help: Enable/Disable API logging for the Dapr sidecar.

parameters.name: --dapr-app-id
parameters.help: The Dapr application identifier.

parameters.name: --dapr-app-port
parameters.help: The port Dapr uses to communicate to the application.

parameters.name: --dapr-http-max-request-size
parameters.help: Max size of request body http and grpc servers in MB to handle uploading of large files.

parameters.name: --dapr-http-read-buffer-size
parameters.help: Max size of http header read buffer in KB to handle when sending multi-KB headers.

parameters.name: --dapr-log-level
parameters.help: The log level for the Dapr sidecar.

parameters.name: --deployment-container-image-name
parameters.help: Container image, e.g. publisher/image-name:tag. WARNING: Option '--deployment-container-image-name' has been deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Use '--image' instead.

parameters.name: --deployment-local-git
parameters.help: Enable local git.

parameters.name: --deployment-source-branch
parameters.help: The branch to deploy.

parameters.name: --deployment-source-url
parameters.help: Git repository URL to link with manual integration.

parameters.name: --deployment-storage-auth-type
parameters.help: The deployment storage account authentication type.

parameters.name: --deployment-storage-auth-value
parameters.help: The deployment storage account authentication value. For the user-assigned managed identity authentication type, this should be the user assigned identity resource id. For the storage account connection string authentication type, this should be the name of the app setting that will contain the storage account connection string. For the system assigned managed- identity authentication type, this parameter is not applicable and should be left empty.

parameters.name: --deployment-storage-container-name
parameters.help: The deployment storage account container name.

parameters.name: --deployment-storage-name
parameters.help: The deployment storage account name.

parameters.name: --disable-app-insights
parameters.help: Disable creating application insights resource during functionapp create. No logs will be available.

parameters.name: --docker-registry-server-password
parameters.help: The container registry server password. Required for private registries. WARNING: Option '--docker-registry-server-password' has been deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Use '--registry-password' instead.

parameters.name: --docker-registry-server-user
parameters.help: The container registry server username. WARNING: Option '--docker-registry-server-user' has been deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Use '--registry-username' instead.

parameters.name: --domain-name-scope
parameters.help: Specify the scope of uniqueness for the default hostname during resource creation.

parameters.name: --enable-dapr
parameters.help: Enable/Disable Dapr for a function app on an Azure Container App environment.

parameters.name: --environment
parameters.help: Name of the container app environment. WARNING: Argument '--environment' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --flexconsumption-location
parameters.help: Geographic location where function app will be hosted. Use `az functionapp list- flexconsumption-locations` to view available locations.

parameters.name: --functions-version
parameters.help: The functions app version. NOTE: This will be required starting the next release cycle.

parameters.name: --https-only
parameters.help: Redirect all traffic made to an app using HTTP to HTTPS.

parameters.name: --image
parameters.help: Container image, e.g. publisher/image-name:tag.

parameters.name: --instance-memory
parameters.help: The instance memory size in MB. See https://aka.ms/flex-instance-sizes for more information on the supported values.

parameters.name: --max-replicas
parameters.help: The maximum number of replicas when create function app on container app. WARNING: Argument '--max-replicas' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --maximum-instance-count
parameters.help: The maximum number of instances.

parameters.name: --memory
parameters.help: The memory size of the container app. e.g. 1.0Gi,. WARNING: Argument '--memory' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --min-replicas
parameters.help: The minimum number of replicas when create function app on container app. WARNING: Argument '--min-replicas' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --os-type
parameters.help: Set the OS type for the app to be created.

parameters.name: --plan
parameters.help: Name or resource id of the functionapp app service plan. Use 'appservice plan create' to get one. If using an App Service plan from a different resource group, the full resource id must be used and not the plan name.

parameters.name: --registry-password
parameters.help: The container registry server password. Required for private registries.

parameters.name: --registry-server
parameters.help: The container registry server hostname, e.g. myregistry.azurecr.io. WARNING: Argument '--registry-server' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --registry-username
parameters.help: The container registry server username.

parameters.name: --role
parameters.help: Role name or id the system assigned identity will have.

parameters.name: --runtime
parameters.help: The functions runtime stack. Use "az functionapp list-runtimes" to check supported runtimes and versions.

parameters.name: --runtime-version
parameters.help: The version of the functions runtime stack. The functions runtime stack. Use "az functionapp list-runtimes" to check supported runtimes and versions.

parameters.name: --scope
parameters.help: Scope that the system assigned identity can access.

parameters.name: --subnet
parameters.help: Name or resource ID of the pre-existing subnet to have the webapp join. The --vnet is argument also needed if specifying subnet by name.

parameters.name: --tags
parameters.help: Space-separated tags: key[=value] [key[=value]...]. Use '' to clear existing tags.

parameters.name: --vnet
parameters.help: Name or resource ID of the regional virtual network. If there are multiple vnets of the same name across different resource groups, use vnet resource id to specify which vnet to use. If vnet name is used, by default, the vnet in the same resource group as the webapp will be used. Must be used with --subnet argument.

parameters.name: --workload-profile-name
parameters.help: The workload profile name to run the container app on. WARNING: Argument '--workload-profile-name' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --workspace
parameters.help: Name of an existing log analytics workspace to be used for the application insights component.

parameters.name: --zone-redundant
parameters.help: Enable zone redundancy for high availability. Applies to Flex Consumption SKU only.

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --only-show-errors
parameters.help: Only show errors, suppressing warnings.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.help: Output format.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
